question: A retailer buys 12 pairs of shoes for ₹22,400. His overhead expenses are ₹1,600. If he earns ₹28,500 from the sale of these 12 pair of shoes, determine his profit percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total CP = Base CP + Overhead = 22400 + 1600 = 24000

Ratio of CP : SP = 24000 : 28500 = 16 : 19

Profit = 19 − 16 = 3 units on a CP base of 16 units

Profit % = (3 ÷ 16) × 100 = 18.75%

**∴ The correct answer is 18.75%.**
